change: Connect the common Inspector help disclosure button to its unique help text using aria-controls and a stable per-field id.

assertions: aria-controls identifies the corresponding help element.
Opening the disclosure exposes the help text and sets aria-expanded=true.
The tested selection, undo, save/reload, separate publish, and public parity lifecycle remains passing.

all_partial_types_test.coverage: All 44 PARTIAL element types; every visible typed Inspector field's help id, aria-controls relationship, and initial collapsed state, alongside existing responsive, state, draft Save, reload, separate Publish, and public rendering checks.

release.reason: Zero-cost constraint; GitHub Actions overage and Cloudflare usage are not currently verified as free.

acceptance_boundary: This proves the shared help disclosure relationship and its regression path only. Full 77.44.7.A, all-type/property acceptance, production acceptance, and physical device acceptance remain open.
